children.zh-CN: 徽章所附着的元素，徽章相对它定位；不传时徽章作为独立元素显示。
children.en-US: The element the badge is attached to; the badge is positioned relative to it. Without children, the badge is shown as a standalone element.

className.en-US: Class name of the root `span` element.

classNames.zh-CN: 内部各部位的类名，键为 `count`，与组件自带的类名合并。
classNames.en-US: Class names of the inner parts, keyed by `count`; merged with the built-in classes.

count.zh-CN: 徽章内容，数字和字符串按文字显示；其他 ReactNode 直接渲染，此时不带 `type` 与 `theme` 对应的样式类。
count.en-US: Badge content. Numbers and strings are shown as text; other nodes are rendered as is, without the `type` and `theme` classes.

dot.en-US: Shows a small dot instead of `count`.

onClick.en-US: Called when the root element is clicked.

onMouseEnter.zh-CN: 鼠标移入根元素时调用。
onMouseEnter.en-US: Called when the pointer enters the root element.

onMouseLeave.zh-CN: 鼠标移出根元素时调用。
onMouseLeave.en-US: Called when the pointer leaves the root element.

overflowCount.zh-CN: 数字 `count` 的最大展示值，超出后显示为 `${overflowCount}+`；只对数字生效，`0` 视为未设置。
overflowCount.en-US: Maximum number shown; a larger numeric `count` is displayed as `${overflowCount}+`. Applies to numbers only, and `0` is treated as unset.

position.zh-CN: 徽章相对被包裹元素的位置，可选 `leftTop`、`leftBottom`、`rightTop`、`rightBottom`；未设置时在 RTL 的 ConfigProvider 下为 `leftTop`，否则为 `rightTop`。
position.en-US: Badge position relative to the wrapped element: `leftTop`, `leftBottom`, `rightTop` or `rightBottom`. When unset, it is `leftTop` under an RTL ConfigProvider and `rightTop` otherwise.

styles.zh-CN: 内部各部位的内联样式，键同 `classNames`。
styles.en-US: Inline styles of the inner parts, keyed like `classNames`.
